items.title: Jason Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2025
items.q: when I was a student at New England Conservatory I befriended the great trumpet player Jeremy Pelt.

ctx.x: You know when I was a student at New England Conservatory I befriended the great trumpet player Jeremy Pelt. He pulled me off the street, he literally pulled me off the

street — I was walking down Mass Ave in Boston, had my trumpet case over my back, and I was coming back from Tower Records going down Mass Ave, past Berklee, which he was about to graduate from, and I was going towards New England Conservatory. He saw a trumpet on my back and he said, “You play trumpet?” I said, “Yeah.” He said, “Are you going to Berklee?” I said, “No I go to NEC.” He said, “Oh, you’re going to NEC.” And so he said, “I want you to come with me.” And this was on a Sunday. So we walked down Mass…
